Package nl.pim16aap2.lightkeeper.protocol

Record Class ServerErrorEntry

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
nl.pim16aap2.lightkeeper.protocol.ServerErrorEntry
Record Components:
timestampMillis - Epoch milliseconds at which the log event was created.
severity - Severity bucket derived from the numeric log level: "ERROR" for error-or-worse events, "WARNING" otherwise.
levelName - Original log level name (e.g. "ERROR", "WARN", "FATAL") for display purposes.
loggerName - Name of the logger that emitted the event.
threadName - Name of the thread that emitted the event.
message - Formatted log message.
throwableClass - Fully-qualified class name of the attached throwable, or null when the event carried none.
throwableMessage - Message of the attached throwable, or null when absent.
stackTrace - Rendered stack trace lines of the attached throwable including its cause chain (possibly truncated); empty when the event carried no throwable.
public record ServerErrorEntry(long timestampMillis, String severity, String levelName, String loggerName, String threadName, String message, @Nullable String throwableClass, @Nullable String throwableMessage, List<String> stackTrace) extends Record
Typed snapshot of a single captured server error or warning, carried directly inside protocol responses.

Entries are captured by the agent's Log4j appender as structured log events, so the throwable metadata reflects the actual Throwable attached to the log event rather than text scraped from console output.
